estimator: Median of 100 per-episode planner medians in each cell; pooled decision median also retained. CPU/RSS medians over episodes.
limitations: Descriptive timings from serial study runs, not randomized isolated speed benchmarks.
Network-call counts do not determine end-to-end latency; batching, simulator stepping, planning and logging contribute.
Training/acquisition/audit cost excluded; no training efficiency comparison assigned.
Running timer may exclude workstation suspension; UTC calendar and sleep diagnosis are reported separately.
Control quality, population uncertainty, solver qualification and reproduction are separate pending checks.
scope: Descriptive measured runtime and work for the completed primary control cohort
